research_question: Can spot-versus-perpetual price leadership resolve the time instability of OI buildup continuation and distinguish information delivery from leverage-only overshoot before entry?

scenario.context: an abnormal five-minute return and aggressive-flow episode in either Binance spot or USD-M perpetual futures

state_router.SPOT_LED_POSITION_BUILDUP: spot leads the directional return with abnormal spot volume and aggressor flow while perpetual base OI builds
state_router.PERP_LED_DELEVERAGING: perpetual futures lead the directional return with abnormal futures volume and aggressor flow while base OI collapses
state_router.UNRESOLVED: neither market has sufficiently distinct leadership or OI state

independent_confirmation.SPOT_LED_POSITION_BUILDUP: spot does not reverse, futures catch up, OI does not unwind, futures flow remains aligned, composite index follows and peer spot breadth agrees; trade continuation after the confirmation close
independent_confirmation.PERP_LED_DELEVERAGING: spot does not follow, the lead gap repairs, OI stops collapsing and futures flow opposes the event; trade reversal after the confirmation close

scenario.invalidation_target_note: This is a mechanism screen. Any surviving route must be frozen with event-extreme invalidation, same-leg objectives and current-NAV 3% risk sizing in NautilusTrader.

data.futures_source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly futures klines and indexPriceKlines
data.visibility: all event and confirmation inputs are joined at their native completed five-minute timestamp

evaluation.same_event_arbitration: largest fixed leadership-state quality score, then symbol
evaluation.overlap_policy: no new selected episode until the active route horizon completes

decision_contract.advance: Only a predeclared route/router passing development, year-long stability and the latest July 2026 holdout may be frozen for NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not adjust numeric thresholds after these results. Preserve only a route that is positive across all declared splits and move to another independent mechanism.
